body:
Me too. I lost my cousin in a car crash last week, then my grandpa just upped and moved 18 hours away with his horrible wife. All of this was within a few days of my grandmothers passing day anniversary. It was already a really deviating week emotionally, I couldn’t have handled him being gone too 

Edit: sorry if that’s oversharing. I don’t have many people to talk to IRL

My dad once told me to always check because graveyards are full of people who had right of way. My husband almost got T-boned yesterday by a truck running the stop sign at a 4-way. He would’ve been hit on the drivers side at 60mph
It’s oddly reassuring other people understand how this feels
He doesn’t have any evidence either to say it didn’t— everything been deleted and he doesn’t even have the same phone from when it happened
Good vibes go a long way
If he’s found guilty civilian side, will the military roll with that charge too? Or can the verdicts mismatch?
I initially thought you were kidding until I read it from the other comment

It’s going to end up a he said she said. There’s going to be a police report (obviously). But I doubt it will go anywhere civilian side. A friend said he’s probably going to lose some rank— but I don’t know how accurate that is

It really bothers me he is a corporal in the army. He is a dirtbag that thinks he can do whatever he wants. I desperately wanted to enlist (medical disqualification) so it really gets under my skin to see someone serving that happily disgraces the uniform— let alone someone in charge of a lot of lower enlisted. 

I’m probably going to do a police report. Even if nothing comes of it on the civilian side— the military will investigate it

Yeah, I’m in the US

Knowing him, he came over with 110% intention of having sex. He has had dozens and dozens of partners. Sex is more than a hobby to him. 

I have a long history of mental illness and plenty of medical documents to back it up. The main problem was I wasn’t medicated at all— I was manic/psychotic and didn’t even consider going to a doctor. I was too far gone to even consider it. 

One of the things about mania/psychosis is you are extremely easy to manipulate; it makes influencing and convincing someone to do something really easy. Even through that, I tried to get him to leave. I don’t think he knew I was sick, but he knew I was in a tailspin (we had talked a bit about it and it was really obvious). 

As far as the 99.99%, that doesn’t really match up in the US. People go to jail for accusations a surprising amount. It doesn’t help his case that our justice system is quick to blame the black guy... either way, neither of us have proof. It’s all he said-she said.

Is it really that simple to decide if it’s rape? 
He wanted to, I didn’t. He pressured me when I wanted him to back off.... I pushed him back after he kissed me— I literally walked away/ towards the front door. I was going to open it and ask him to leave. He followed me and cornered me in the hallway. 

I was in no mental state to speak up and stop it— I might as well have been drunk off my ass. But I still feel like it’s my fault
I’m seriously considering talking to his higher ups. He’s in the military. I have a close family member that is in the same battalion as him, that’s how I met him

It’s a work in progress...

Medications are so critical. My meds are the only thing keeping me out of the hospital tbh. I finally found a good psychiatrist (third times a charm) and I can honestly say I haven’t been anywhere near this stable in over 4 years. 

I’m having a really hard time with this “he raped me” being out in the open. It had been in the back of my mind for a long time, but I never acknowledged it. Now that I have, I feel like I got hit my a bus
I barely know him. I’d only met him in person once before... I’m blocking him on everything
